title: Transition (StepResult / ResetResult)
description: Shape of one Step() return value (Sts2Emulator.Dto.StepResult) and, for the initial state, ResetFromScenario's ResetResult (same Observation/LegalActions shape, no ActionId/Reward/Done/Info). Source of truth: Sts2Emulator/Dto/StepResult.cs, Dto/ResetResult.cs, Dto/GameObservation.cs. STS2_RL/Combat/emulator_bridge.py currently only surfaces a reduced observation_to_dict() (turn/is_terminal/outcome/state) - a full RL-facing env wrapper (plan Phase 1's CombatEnv) should surface reward/done/legal_actions/info too, matching this schema, not just observation_to_dict's subset.

action_id.description: Echoes the action_id that was passed to Step().

reward.description: Engine-native reward signal, if any is populated (plan section 7.1: STS2_RL should compute its own reward from `observation`/`info` deltas rather than relying solely on this - reward shaping stays a Python-side concern per the mid-term plan's architecture principle 12.6).

done.description: True once combat/run has ended (mirrors observation.is_terminal).

legal_actions.description: Legal actions for the state observation reflects - i.e. for the NEXT decision, not the one just taken.

info.description: Free-form diagnostic dict; shape not yet standardized. Extend/document here once STS2_RL/Combat/env consumes specific keys from it.

game_observation.description: Sts2Emulator.Dto.GameObservation. The typed Player/Enemies/Hand/Relics/StatusEffects/Metrics/Extras fields predate the 'State' full-state dict and are kept only for backward-compat CLI rendering (per GameObservation.cs's own doc comment) - STS2_RL code should read from 'state', not those typed fields.

outcome.description: e.g. '', 'Victory', 'Defeat' - exact value set not yet enumerated from source; treat as opaque until confirmed.
